source.label: TEL FY2025 and 1H2026 PSE financial report

TEL.route_reason: FCFF/SOTP remains primary; P/E is a finite screen while capex, data-center, tower, and claim bridges remain incomplete.
TEL.intrinsic_blocker: A reviewed FCFF/SOTP separating connectivity, data centers, towers, debt, leases, and minority claims is not complete.

GLO.route_reason: FCFF/SOTP remains primary; P/E is a finite screen while capex, tower, preferred, and claim bridges remain incomplete.
GLO.intrinsic_blocker: A reviewed FCFF/SOTP with tower monetization, debt, leases, preferred shares, and minority claims is not complete.

CNVRG.metric_label: FY2025 reported book value per share
CNVRG.route_reason: Subscriber-driven FCFF remains primary; P/B is a finite screen pending network capex and customer-economics reconciliation.
CNVRG.intrinsic_blocker: A reviewed subscriber, capex, debt, lease, and terminal network-economics bridge is incomplete.

DITO.metric_label: FY2025 consolidated revenue per outstanding common share
DITO.route_reason: SOTP/subscriber-ramp DCF remains primary; P/S provides a finite screen while equity is negative.
DITO.intrinsic_blocker: Negative parent equity and unresolved subsidiary ownership, debt, spectrum, capex, and subscriber economics block intrinsic SOTP.

NOW.metric_label: FY2025 reported book value per share
NOW.route_reason: FCFF remains primary; P/B provides a finite screen pending normalized cash flow and network investment review.
NOW.intrinsic_blocker: Normalized recurring cash flow, network capex, debt, and small-company liquidity adjustments are not fully reconciled.

GMA7.route_reason: FCFF/distributions remain primary; P/E provides a finite screen amid sharp 2026 earnings pressure.
GMA7.intrinsic_blocker: Structural linear-media decline and the sharp 2026 earnings contraction require refreshed cash-flow normalization.

source.label: ABS FY2025 PSE financial report and 2026 recapitalization review

ABS.metric_label: FY2025 revenue per post-recapitalization common share
ABS.route_reason: NAV/SOTP remains primary; P/S provides a finite diluted screen during restructuring.
ABS.intrinsic_blocker: Continuing losses, negative 1H2026 equity, content and real-estate value, and the 2026 share issuance require a refreshed post-money SOTP.

MB.metric_label: FY2025 reported book value per share
MB.route_reason: Normalized FCFF remains primary; P/B provides a finite screen for a legacy media asset.
MB.intrinsic_blocker: Structural print decline, digital transition, and normalized owner cash flow are not fully reconciled.

DFNN.metric_label: FY2025 revenue per outstanding common share
DFNN.route_reason: FCFF remains primary; P/S provides a finite screen while equity and earnings are negative.
DFNN.intrinsic_blocker: Negative equity, losses, current-liability pressure, and unresolved licensing economics block intrinsic FCFF.

PLUS.route_reason: FCFF remains primary; P/E provides a finite screen amid changing gaming regulation.
PLUS.intrinsic_blocker: Regulatory transition, platform economics, and the proposed offline investment require a refreshed FCFF bridge.
